0022600029.text: The Grizzlies (6-1, 2-1 at home, 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) are coming off a loss and host the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 5th in the West, 2nd in the Northwest) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost all three meetings with Oklahoma City in 2025-26, most recently a 117-116 home defeat on January 9, 2026.
